function.name: CreateSubSession
function.description: Create a sub-session for handling complex or independent tasks that require separate context and memory. The sub-session works on the query with its own conversation and its own memory file, then its answer is returned as the result of this tool call. Use it for a self-contained sub task instead of doing everything in the current conversation.

query.description: The task the sub-session has to work on. This is the only input the sub-session receives: it starts with an empty conversation and cannot see the current one, so the query must be fully self-contained and include every detail, constraint and expected output format the sub-session needs.

tools.description: The tools the sub-session is allowed to use.

items.description: A tool the sub-session can call.

name.description: The registered tool name, for example SearchKnowledgeBase.

args.description: The preset arguments for the tool.
